issues.event: Bluesky launched Attie at Atmosphere conference
issues.article_text: O Bluesky lançou o Attie, primeiro app agentic no AT Protocol, usando Claude para criar feeds personalizados.
issues.detail: Attie was presented at the Atmosphere conference and reported by TechCrunch on March 28, one day before the edition window opened (March 29 10:00 BRT). Later articles (Economic Times, Indian Express on March 30) are follow-up coverage of the same event, not a new development.
